question: Does any current speech-native/full-duplex candidate provide source-grounded German capability evidence strong enough to remain a production-voice candidate under Trigger 7?
interpretation: Native full-duplex remains a research/reference lane. Lane A modular German realtime remains the production-leading hypothesis until a pinned full-duplex checkpoint proves German input/output and interaction quality on the Trigger-7 benchmark. This is not a claim that every candidate is incapable of German; for several candidates German support is simply not established by current primary sources.

candidate_findings.evidence: Official FAQ states Moshi is not multilingual and only speaks English; limited translation snippets are not full other-language operation.
Official/project documentation declares bilingual realtime speech conversation in English and Chinese.
Published Hugging Face model card is tagged Chinese and English and provides the full-duplex checkpoint; no German production evidence is published there.
Official repository says inference code, deployment recipes and model checkpoints are not yet released.
Current technical report contains Chinese/English ASR and translation evaluations and English empathetic-dialogue evaluation; no German evidence was found in the report.
Official project demonstrates Mandarin and English question answering; current reviewed official repository/project surfaces do not establish German speech dialogue.
Official model card establishes native full-duplex behavior and released weights but does not state German support.

DuplexOmni is a released full-duplex Qwen3-Omni-derived interaction stack. Its paper reports training dialogue data mainly Chinese (~70%) and English (~30%) with a small amount of other languages and does not publish German full-duplex results. However, the official Qwen3-Omni base explicitly supports German speech input and output, so German capability may survive the duplex adaptation and must be measured rather than dismissed.

counterhypothesis: A full-duplex fine-tune built on a multilingual speech backbone may retain useful German despite absent German-specific upstream reporting.
cheapest_next_falsifier: After a valid clay-direct-dev hardware/resource receipt, run a pinned German listen-speak-interrupt micro-suite on DuplexOmni first because its Qwen3-Omni base has explicit German speech input/output support. Measure intelligibility, semantic correctness, interruption behavior, TTFA and resource fit; do not grant production credit from the base model language list alone.
